brief_title: A Study of DBPR108 and Metformin Hydrochloride Combination Therapy in Patients With T2DM
official_title: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Parallel Controlled Phase III Clinical Trial of DBRP108 in Combination With Metformin Hydrochloride in the Treatment of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus

lead_sponsor.name: CSPC ZhongQi Pharmaceutical Technology Co., Ltd.

primary_outcomes.measure: Change in HbA1c (%) from baseline to week 24

brief_summary: This study aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of DBPR108 tablets in combination with metformin hydrochloride in the treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus. A total of 210 subjects will be randomly assigned in a ratio of 2:1 to receive metformin hydrochloride plus DBPR108 or metformin hydrochloride plus placebo.
